shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh themed pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World (placement, level map, settings, map toggle) → 2 Entry (gizmo, right-click, party dialog, pocket map, exit, once-per-pawn) → 3 Map generation (themes, chambers, dividers) → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework (ocean dungeons).
Phase 1 written (builds 1-3, reviewed at 3), not yet tested in game.

## World (phase 1)
- `DungeonWorldComponent` holds every dungeon as plain data: parallel arrays of surface tile id + level (ushort), saved as byte arrays, plus `genVersion` and `generatedMaxLevel`. Not WorldObjects: thousands of them would slow the world map. A real site object is made only when a caravan needs one (phase 2).
- Placement (`Generate`): tiles in a seeded random order; each eligible tile takes a dungeon and blocks every tile within spacing-1 steps (BFS over neighbours), so dungeons are at least `spacing` apart. Eligible: no world object on it, land not impassable; water only with Vehicle Framework active and the ocean setting on.
- Levels: 3-octave Perlin over the unit sphere (frequency = roughness setting). Values are ranked; rank fraction p gives level 1 + floor(p^skew × max). Every level gets dungeons, low ones more often as skew rises.
- Runs on a new world and on the first load of a save without dungeon data (genVersion mismatch). Settings changes reach only new generations; dev action "Regenerate dungeons" reruns it, "Log dungeon levels" logs counts per level.
- A dungeon whose tile has a MapParent (settlement, site, colony) is blocked: no icon, no inspect line.
- `WorldDrawLayer_Dungeons` (added to the Surface PlanetLayerDef by patch): one batched mesh, render queue 3530 (under world objects). Icon tinted green → yellow → red → purple by level / generated max (12 steps), or plain. Opacity is the layer Alpha, so changing it needs no rebuild. Rebuilt when the map-parent count changes or settings are written.
- World map toggle in the bottom-right play settings row (Harmony postfix on PlaySettings.DoWorldViewControls). Tile inspect text shows "Dungeon: level N" (postfix on WorldInspectPane.TileInspectString getter).

## Settings (tabs; reset bottom left)
- World tab: show icons, icon opacity (60%), tint by level, spacing (3), max level (30), low level bias (1.5; the description shows the resulting share of levels ≤10 and at max), roughness (3), ocean dungeons with VF.
- Planned tabs: Creatures, Rewards, Parties.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Each party entering gets a freshly generated dungeon; level never changes. Leave by walking back to the entrance at any time; exit screen like Anomaly's pit gate, listing items on the map, pawns carry chosen items out. No boss, no time limit. If every party member dies, the instance is gone; downed doesn't count.
- Entry: "Enter dungeon" gizmo on a caravan on the tile, and right-click → enter dungeon with a caravan selected (like trade).
- Party: up to 5 humanlikes (animals and mechs free). A pawn may enter a given dungeon once; a party containing such a pawn can't enter.
- Effective level = level × wealth modifier (pawns + their gear only; ratio in settings). Points from effective level linear for now.
- Creatures: humanlikes (xenotypes), animals, insects, mechs if feasible. Total points from effective level, variable count, packs. Dungeon Madness (scaria without rot) near-guaranteed; a pack where 2+ roll without madness is entirely free of it. Creatures without madness can be tamed. Undiscovered rooms keep creatures suspended.
- Rewards: entads via EntadApi, points from effective level, scattered; binding single / whole party / unbound by settings chances.
- Hard deps: Entad Framework, Titan Framework, Harmony (About.xml; the frameworks have no Workshop URLs until published). Vehicle Framework optional, loadAfter only.

## Textures
- World/TUBAD_Dungeon (white arch, tinted at runtime), UI/TUBAD_ShowDungeons (toggle). Placeholder SVG art.
